description: Marine and Harbours Act Areas (DOT-003) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport. Areas declared under the Marine and Harbours Act 1981. Polygon dataset forming part of DoT's Marine Administrative Boundaries captured for the purposes of the CFM Information Review. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport. Its tags are act, admin, administrative, boundaries, harbour. It offers 2 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, wms. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
